summary: Iteration 13 / V4.2 backend testing — focused on the V4.2 deltas: ?confirm=WIPE gate, X-Forwarded-For-pinned brute-force lock, character /transfer (auto member-add + effective_level decoration), GET /campaigns/{cid}/members, EffectIn.target_character_id, /api/ws/campaign/{cid} room WS with channel:msg fan-out. 18/18 new tests pass. Whole-suite (iter9 + iter10 + iter11 + iter12 + iter13) = 82 PASS / 28 SKIP / 0 FAIL — matches the prior 64/28/0 baseline + 18 new.

minor.issue: Server calls `await ws.close(code=44xx)` BEFORE `await ws.accept()` for invalid-token / 4404 / non-member paths. Behind Starlette this surfaces to the websockets client as an HTTP rejection during the handshake (e.g. HTTP 403 / InvalidStatus) rather than a normal close frame carrying the custom 4xxx code. Functionally fine — connection is rejected — but a strict client cannot read the policy reason. Same pattern lives in /api/ws/session/{sid} (pre-existing). Fix would be to `await ws.accept(); await ws.close(code=4xxx)` if the spec wants the custom codes wire-visible.

K8s ingress only routes /api/* to the backend, so the public preview URL serves the SPA at /openapi.json. The spec is only fetchable via the internal http://localhost:8001/openapi.json (consistent with iter11/iter12 tests). Consider adding a `/api/openapi.json` alias for external tooling.

Lock keys on the LEFT-most X-Forwarded-For entry. K8s ingress prepends its own hop, so a deployed client's real IP is no longer first — but this is still strictly more reliable than `request.client.host` (which rotates per-pod). Acceptable trade-off; document that the lock is per-(client-XFF, email).

action_items: (Optional) Switch ws_session / ws_campaign to `await ws.accept()` BEFORE `await ws.close(code=4xxx)` so callers can read the policy reason on rejection.
(Optional) Mount openapi.json under /api/openapi.json for external tooling — current path is unreachable from the public preview URL.

(Optional, pre-existing) /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py errors at collection if REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL isn't already in the env (no dotenv load). Add a load_dotenv at top of that file or replace os.environ[..] with os.environ.get(.., default).
Frontend (V2 features) was not covered this round — user is smoke-testing Battlemap LoS / measure / ring-binding and Channels @mention / image attachments / WS realtime in the browser.

rca of the issue: No bugs found in V4.2 backend. All 8 V4.2 features verified end-to-end. Pre-existing minor: WS close-before-accept pattern means custom 4xxx close codes are not wire-visible — clients see HTTP-handshake-level rejection instead. Reproduction: any websockets-client connecting with a bad token to /api/ws/campaign/{cid} sees `InvalidStatus: HTTP 403` rather than `ConnectionClosed code=4401`. Mitigation already applied in test (accept either rejection mode). Permanent fix: `await ws.accept(); await ws.close(code=4xxx)` in sessions.py.
